Hum bore nahi hote; hum boredom ke pehle hi notification khol dete hain.

Lift ka 18-second safar, queue me khade rehna, raat ko batti band karne ke baad ka do minute—har khaali jagah ko phone bahut jaldi bhar deta hai. Isme koi moral failure nahi hai. Apps isi kaam me bahut achhe ho gaye hain.

Lekin boredom ek khaali kamra nahi, ek workshop hai. Wahi par dimaag purani baaton ko jodta hai aur kabhi-kabhi ek zaroori idea ko bolne deta hai.

Har hafte ek ghanta rakho jisme podcast, feed, ya background video nahi. Walk kar lo ya balcony me baitho. Pehle das minute me dimaag content maangega. Use kuch mat do.

Observation ki training ke liye [[Chai ki aakhri chuski]] padho; phir [[Sheher ko paidal padhna]] ke saath walk par niklo.
